scope: Raw-sample Scope cursor, viewing-window zoom, numeric component selection and up to three recorded runs overlaid on common axes

browser.engine: Windows installed Chromium, headless, isolated browser contexts
browser.regressionCommand: node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test tests/e2e/scope-time-range.spec.ts tests/e2e/m4-workspace.spec.ts tests/e2e/m10-editor.spec.ts tests/e2e/m13-editor.spec.ts tests/e2e/m17-learning.spec.ts tests/e2e/workspace.spec.ts --config=.test-generated/m18-regression.config.ts
checks: Actual Worker vector results and nearest raw-sample cursor with earlier ties
Drag/numeric viewing windows preserve model and complete immutable history
Common-axis overlays keep separate real timestamps on different sample grids
Exact uint64 codes versus explicitly approximate plot coordinates
Keyboard reference chooses a curve with samples in the viewing interval
Incompatible units reject overlay; deleted records release comparison slots
Singleton observations and escaped HTML labels
Recorded dashboard observations retain cursor/window/component after theme/model-title renders
1440/390/320px dark/light and200% text enlargement without page/panel overflow
Existing Scope simulation-time extension, experiments, dashboards, learning and canvas interactions
correctionsBeforeFinal: NaN legacy test changed to assert gaps and isolated finite points; structured-output field/payload/order guidance restored
New browser test locators aligned with actual run button accessible name and visible experiment tab
Range input native margin removed after measured narrow-panel overflow
Recorded samples memoized and keyboard reference corrected after independent review

visualReview.retention: temporary local output; not application inputs

security.rendering: React-escaped text and fixed SVG attributes; no HTML/eval interpolation
security.inputs: Validated plain data properties; no getters/hooks. Maximum3 runs,10,001 samples/run,1,024 cells/signal,1,000,000 total inspected time+signal cells;160-character IDs/labels and64-character UI numeric drafts
security.model: Observation does not execute the engine or mutate model, execution settings, history or raw samples
security.accountsNetworkPersonalData: No added accounts, server routes, database, remote requests, tracking or personal-data collection

notVerified: Automatic numeric plots of boolean, complex, string, enum, bus or message signals
